content.comment_body: Hello, I want to configure a single push button with two different actions: a short press should activate one output, while a long press (over 2 seconds) should trigger another output. Currently, both outputs are activated during a long press due to the way the on-delay is set up. What method can prevent the short press output from being triggered during a long press? If anyone has a sample solution for handling short vs. long press actions, that would be helpful.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are attempting to set up a single pushbutton to perform two distinct actions based on the press duration, but find that both outputs are activated during long presses. The key issue is the challenge in crafting logic that accurately separates short and long press events, reflecting that the system or documentation lacks clear guidance on implementing this functionality.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect an easy and dependable way to distinguish between short and long button presses, with clear logic or examples to activate different outputs for each type of input.
